name: youtube_video
description: Download a YouTube video (or audio-only) using yt-dlp with fallback strategies and save it to stash for WebUI preview/download. Use when user says 'download this YouTube video', 'save this YouTube video', or provides a YouTube URL and wants the media file.

format.description: Optional custom yt-dlp format selector (overrides quality)

max_filesize_mb.description: Maximum download size in MB. Default: 250

audio_only.description: If true, download best audio-only stream instead of video
